findings.title: format_amount reimplemented separately in src/billing and src/pay
findings.note: format_amount is defined identically in src/billing/format.py and src/pay/export.py: the same cents-to-string conversion under the same name in two directories, neither importing the other. Consolidating into one shared helper would not change behaviour, and this is not a per-adapter pattern -- there is one representation of a money amount, not one per backend.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: parse_csv reads CSV text; parse_json (src/billing/parse.py) reads JSON text. One adapter per input format is a pattern, not scatter.
parse_json is the JSON-format counterpart to parse_csv; a per-format adapter, not scattered functionality.
